data.long_meaning: Ardavan is a Persian name derived from the word 'ard', meaning 'lion'. It is a strong and powerful name, symbolizing bravery, courage, and strength. In Persian and Islamic culture, lions are often considered royal and majestic creatures, representing the fierce protectors of their lands and families. The name Ardavan carries the meaning “Lion, Warrior” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ardavan usually hope their child will grow to embody lion, warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
